summary: Frontend-only regression for empty-blueprints UX fix on /admin/exams. All 8 scripted flows passed: (1) empty-DB warning card shown with disabled Save and no bp-select; (2) 'Create a blueprint' link navigates to /admin/blueprints and closes dialog; (3) blueprint FIX_TEST_BP created via UI; (4) reopening Schedule Exam shows bp-select and enables Save; (5) exam FIX_TEST_EXAM scheduled with 'Exam scheduled' toast (no 'Blueprint not found'); (6) new exam card appears with 'scheduled' status; (7) exam and blueprint deleted via trash icons; (8) regression: warning card reappears with Save disabled when blueprints empty again.

issues: A11y console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent. Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) inside DialogHeader for both dialogs.
Recharts console warnings: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - ResponsiveContainer parent has 0 size on first render.

action_items: (Low) Add DialogDescription to Schedule Exam and New Blueprint DialogContent to silence accessibility warnings.
(Low) Fix Recharts container sizing on Admin Overview (parent needs explicit min height/width).
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted FIX_TEST_BP and FIX_TEST_EXAM via UI. DB left clean (blueprints=0, exams=0) as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Empty-blueprint UX fix verified working end-to-end. DB is clean. Only remaining low-priority items are a11y (DialogDescription) and Recharts sizing warnings.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 'Blueprint not found' bug caused by empty DB + form allowing empty blueprint_id submission. Fix (conditional warning card + disabled Save + save() guards) is confirmed effective.
